title: 第一卷 第5章 首次暴击第一卷 第6章 峰主归来
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
林枫看着跪在地上、眼神透着一股韧劲的小女孩，忍不住勾起一抹笑容。
这可是实打实的天命之女，天生极品太阴之体和隐藏的仙灵根，天赋堪称顶尖。
放着这么一块绝世璞玉在身边，只要好好培养，靠系统返利暴击，他十年的废体颓势，绝对能彻底逆转！
“起来吧。”
林枫抬手，一股温润柔和的灵气托住柳雨姝的身子，将她稳稳扶起。
柳雨姝才11岁，此时站起来也只有他腰间那么高。
林枫目光落在柳雨姝瘦小单薄的身上。
只见她穿得破破烂烂，浑身沾满泥巴，身上到处都是大大小小的伤疤。
先前他忙着救下柳雨姝，并没有仔细看他身上的伤势。
此刻仔细看了，便忍不住心生怜惜。
他对修仙世界的残酷程度又心惊了一刹。
不过，薅羊毛归薅羊毛，他疼爱徒弟也绝不是嘴上说说！
“你一路流亡，受尽磨难，又身负重伤，先好生休养一番。”
林枫说着，抬手一抹储物戒。
十年之前魔道入侵大楚，原主的修为跌至筑基境巅峰。
而他穿越过来之后又用完了为数不多的身家，尝试各种修复灵根的方法，如今他的家底可谓是寒酸至极。
一番翻找，最终只摸出三枚最低阶的下品疗伤丹、一块黯淡无光的下品灵石，还有两张快要失效的低阶护身符箓。
这便是他现在全部的家当。
林枫看着手里寥寥无几的资源，有些无奈地摇了摇头。
换做十年前的“他”，这种垃圾资源看都不会多看一眼，如今却成了他能拿得出手的全部家底。

“这三枚疗伤丹你先服下，修复身上伤势，这块灵石你先拿着用，这两张符箓可挡凡人与低阶修士攻击，记得贴身收好。”
林枫将手头全部资源都给了柳雨姝，毫无保留。
并不是他圣母心犯了，而是他清楚大爱师尊系统的规则，想要高额返利，必先真心疼爱弟子、倾尽所有。
况且面对这个楚楚可怜的女帝幼年体，他也实在不想吝啬抠搜的对待她。
柳雨姝捧着手中珍贵的丹药和符箓，小小的身子骤然一震，眼眶瞬间泛红。
这些资源她之前也是接触过的，只是后来家族被灭门，这些东西就再也可望而不可及了。
她一路逃亡，颠沛流离，受尽世人欺凌践踏，早已学会了接受现实和不再期待。
所有人都视她为丧家之犬、冷眼待她，唯有今日刚刚拜入的师尊，给她温暖，护她性命。
师尊明明自己也身负废体、落魄多年，却愿意大方地赠予自己资源！
这份恩情，重逾千斤！
“叮！检测到宿主真心善待弟子，倾尽家底赠予弟子，师徒羁绊加深！”
“弟子柳雨姝好感度：0【表情】25。”
“触发系统暴击返利！随机暴击倍数判定中……”
“恭喜宿主！触发38倍超级暴击！”
“本次赠予资源38倍返还奖励发放！”
“获得：极品洗髓疗伤丹【表情】3、中品灵石【表情】100、完整地品护身灵符【表情】2、修复灵根天地灵气一缕！”
一连串清脆的系统提示音，接连在林枫脑海中炸响。
林枫瞳孔骤然一亮，心中狂喜！
38倍暴击！开局直接欧皇附体！
content_en:
Lin Feng looked at the little girl kneeling on the ground with a tenacious look in her eyes, and couldn't help but smile.
This is a true daughter of destiny, born with the best lunar body and hidden fairy roots, and her talent is top-notch.
With such a peerless piece of jade by his side, as long as he cultivates it well and relies on system rebates and critical hits, his ten-year decline can definitely be completely reversed!
"Get up."
Lin Feng raised his hand, and a warm and soft spiritual energy supported Liu Yushu's body, holding her up steadily.
Liu Yushu is only 11 years old, and when she stands, she is only as high as his waist.
Lin Feng's eyes fell on Liu Yushu's thin and frail body.
She was dressed in rags, covered in mud, and had scars of various sizes all over her body.
He was busy saving Liu Yushu before and didn't take a closer look at his injuries.
Now that I looked at it carefully, I couldn't help but feel pity.
He was frightened for a moment by the cruelty of the world of cultivating immortals.
However, shedding wool is shedding wool, and he loves his apprentice more than just words!
"You have been in exile, suffered a lot, and been seriously injured. You need to take a good rest first."
Lin Feng said, raising his hand and touching the storage ring.
Ten years ago, the devil invaded Dachu, and the original owner's cultivation level dropped to the peak of the foundation building realm.
And after he traveled through time, he used up the little money he had and tried various methods to repair his spiritual roots. Now his family is extremely shabby.
After some rummaging, I finally found only three low-grade healing pills of the lowest grade, a dull low-grade spiritual stone, and two low-grade amulets that were about to expire.
This is all his property now.
Lin Feng looked at the few resources in his hand and shook his head helplessly.
If it were "him" ten years ago, this kind of garbage resource would not even look at it twice, but now it has become all the wealth he can take advantage of.
"You take these three healing pills first to repair your injuries. You take this spiritual stone first. These two talismans can block the attacks of mortals and low-level monks. Remember to keep them close to your body."
Lin Feng gave all the resources at hand to Liu Yushu without reservation.
It's not that his mother's heart is wrong, but that he understands the rules of the Great Love Master system. If he wants a high rebate, he must first truly love his disciples and give everything he has.
Moreover, facing this pitiful young body of the empress, he really didn't want to treat her stingily.
Liu Yushu held the precious elixirs and talismans in her hands, her little body suddenly shook, and her eyes instantly turned red.
She had come into contact with these resources before, but after her family was wiped out, these things were no longer within her reach.
She fled all the way, was displaced, was bullied and trampled by the world, and had long since learned to accept reality and no longer expect.
Everyone regarded her as a lost dog and treated her with cold eyes. Only the master who had just become her master today gave her warmth and protected her life.
Even though the master himself has a broken body and has been in poverty for many years, he is willing to generously donate resources to himself!
This kindness weighs more than a thousand pounds!
"Ding! It's been detected that the host treats his disciples sincerely and spends all his wealth to give them to his disciples. The bond between master and disciple is deepened!"
"Disciple Liu Yushu's favorability: 0 [expression] 25."
"Trigger system critical hit rebate! Random critical hit multiplier is being determined..."
"Congratulations to the host! Triggering a 38x super critical hit!"
"This time, 38 times the resources donated will be returned as rewards!"
"Obtained: top-quality marrow-cleansing healing pills [expression] 3, medium-grade spiritual stones [expression] 100, complete earth-grade protective talismans [expression] 2, and a wisp of spiritual energy to repair the spiritual roots of heaven and earth!"
A series of crisp system prompts sounded in Lin Feng's mind one after another.
Lin Feng's pupils suddenly lit up, and he was ecstatic!
38 times the critical hit! At the beginning, the European Emperor is directly possessed!
